title: Allow pull-request file filtering in extension CI
description: The extension CI workflow invokes a pull-request file filter while its token lacks pull-request read permission. The check fails before tests with Resource not accessible by integration. Add the minimum pull-requests read permission and verify the hosted check completes.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Hosted failure confirmed on the release PR: dorny/paths-filter could not list pull-request files because the workflow token omitted pull-requests read permission. Scope is the minimum permission addition plus hosted rerun.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Applied the minimum job-level pull-requests read permission. YAML parsing and git diff checks pass; the hosted PR check will provide final verification.
